subject.title: feat: validate required run artifacts against a schema (`--require-artifact-schema`)

question: Should this flag enforce a fail-closed Crabbox schema subset, or claim compatibility with general JSON Schema while ignoring unsupported validation keywords?
rationale: That contract determines whether a successful evidence gate reliably means the supplied constraints were enforced; code review cannot choose the intended product guarantee.

options.title: Fail closed on keywords
options.body: Reject schemas containing unsupported validation keywords at preflight and expand the supported subset deliberately over time.

options.title: Define a Crabbox schema
options.body: Rename and document the input as a Crabbox-specific subset so general JSON Schema compatibility is not implied.

options.title: Allow partial validation
options.body: Keep ignoring unsupported constraints and explicitly accept that successful validation may enforce only part of a supplied schema.

recommendation.title: Fail closed on keywords
recommendation.body: Reject schemas containing unsupported validation keywords at preflight and expand the supported subset deliberately over time.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent artifact safety work and broad CLI history make steipete the best available owner for the evidence-contract decision.
